TC-11/S28.detail: Neither display window reads the retention config. In the Hospital timeline, isRecentCourseLine (apps/web/src/domain/courseTimeline.ts:62-68) keeps a dated line only if its label equals today's or yesterday's date (todayCourseLabel / yesterdayCourseLabel). The two-day window is fixed in client code. In the Nursing Home course panel, CoursePanel.tsx:12 sets its own `const SHOW_LAST = 3`. HOSPITAL_RETENTION and SNF_RETENTION in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts are module-private (`const`, not exported) and are used only by the backend purge. SNF_RETENTION does set transcriptVisits: 3, which happens to match SHOW_LAST, but the panel never reads it. So lengthening retention under a hospital affiliation would change what the purge keeps but not what either timeline shows. This goes against UAT 3.6 ("all windows are configuration values"). The oracle says such a window is a finding that becomes a Fail or a pass only once Q15 decides whether the displayed window must follow the config. Both findings are therefore labelled pending:Q15 and the verdict is pending. No recorded gap applies.
TC-11/S28.detailRun2: Neither display window reads the retention config. The Hospital timeline filter, isRecentCourseLine in apps/web/src/domain/courseTimeline.ts, only checks whether a line's date label equals todayCourseLabel or yesterdayCourseLabel. The one-day lookback is written directly into the code (d.setDate(d.getDate() - 1)) and nothing in it refers to HOSPITAL_RETENTION. The Nursing Home course panel uses its own constant, SHOW_LAST = 3, in CoursePanel.tsx. That number happens to equal SNF_RETENTION.transcriptVisits, previousNotes and medicationVisits, but it is not taken from them. HOSPITAL_RETENTION and SNF_RETENTION in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts are module-private (not exported) server constants, and neither has a field for the course timeline. So lengthening retention under a hospital affiliation would not lengthen what either timeline shows. This goes against UAT 3.6 ("All windows are configuration values, not hard-coded"). The oracle hands the final outcome to Q15 (must the derived display follow the config?), so both points are labelled pending:Q15 and the verdict is pending, not fail. No recorded gap applies.
